retrieval.quote: If "compat" and func is a callable, func will be passed each element of the Series, like Series.map. If func is a list or dict of callables, will first try to translate each func into pandas methods. If that doesn’t work, will try call to apply again with by_row="compat" and if that fails, will call apply again with by_row=False (backward compatible). If False, the func will be passed the whole Series at once.
